cards.front: What should you know about photography exam tips?
cards.back: Show BEFORE and AFTER for every edit. Work NON-DESTRUCTIVELY — use layers and masks. Annotate every adjustment (what, why, how much). Discuss the ETHICS of manipulation in your genre. Do not just apply filters — make intentional adjustments.

Students often make mistakes with this topic. Wrong: Editing photos is cheating — a good photograph should not need any post-processing. Correct: ALL photographs need some processing — even film photographers adjusted exposure, contrast and cropping in the darkroom. RAW files specifically REQUIRE processing to look their best. Process the same RAW photograph in three different ways to create three different moods. Show the original alongside each version. Annotate every adjustment and explain its creative purpose.
